name: Plustek OpticFilm 8200i SE (GL128)

hardware_record.result: 66 frames at 7200 dpi, 48-bit linear TIFF; blue offset bug found in these scans

A roll of 35 mm color negatives captured and verified. 7200 dpi: 91 s per frame, 10369 x 7034 px, 437.6 MB. 3600 dpi: about 51 s, 5184 x 3519 px. 900 dpi: 21 s. Same-frame A/B, holder untouched: unpatched, blue is exactly 0 on 5.4% of the frame and on all of the opaque holder; patched, none. 3600 and 7200 dpi resolve the same detail on consumer negatives; 7200 adds only finer grain.

Frames are about 0.18 mm short of the 25 mm area at every resolution (7034 of 7086 rows at 7200 dpi), the same unpatched; likely the color line-distance compensation. Green skips 10-62% of its codes, rising over the first 40 minutes, then steady; red and blue use every code. No IT8 target with the scanner.

notes: SANE status: basic. Infrared is not implemented for GL128.
The holder is positioned by hand; one frame per scan.
The USB serial number string is the firmware date.
